document: ES0243 revision 4, December 2020; applicability includes STM32F042K6, silicon revision A/1 (REV_ID 0x1000)
method: Manual comparison of the primary errata sheet with current firmware configuration; not silicon testing.

review.assessment: No Standby entry or readout-protection configuration is implemented.
GPIO lock registers are not used.
DMA, TSC, general-purpose timer outputs, RTC, I2C, SPI/I2S, USB and CEC are not used. The ARM SysTick timer is separate.
One ADC calibration occurs at boot; no successive calibration sequence.
Single software conversions are read before another starts; no continuous conversion overrun timing dependency.
64 core NOPs after ADCAL clears precede ADEN; at 48 MHz this exceeds four 14 MHz ADC clocks.
No Stop mode. APB operates at 8 MHz during watchdog setup and 48 MHz normally, above twice the LSI frequency.
TE remains set; UART flush waits for TC before the configuration reset.
Smartcard, CTS/RTS, break generation, two-stop-bit receiver timeout and USART SPI-slave modes are not enabled.
Residual noisy-UART limitation. Error flags and line rejection do not prove all corruption is detected. Service wiring is for the bench; the host tool checks configuration readback.
CAN_MCR.TTCM is not enabled; software sends ordinary Classical CAN frames.

remaining: Record actual device revision at bring-up; recheck errata for substitutions. The register-model tests do not reproduce these silicon effects. Full RM0091 PDF download attempts timed out; no complete reference-manual review is claimed.
